description: Synthesia-style video, two-hand, teal/green right / salmon/peach left, Remember Me from Coco, easy tutorial with note labels

right_hand.comment: Right hand plays teal/green labeled notes (C, D, E, etc.)

left_hand.comment: Left hand plays salmon/peach labeled notes (F)

checks: Non-standard color scheme: teal right hand, salmon/peach left hand
Note name labels displayed on falling blocks
Black intro screen for first few seconds
Key signature annotations on left margin (F major)
known_issues: Non-standard color scheme may require custom color calibration
Note labels on blocks may interfere with note detection
Video starts with black screen - keyboard detection needs later frame
